---
title: "Week Results"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis
source("_data.R")
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

# Chronological week order: regular season 1-18, then playoffs
week_levels <- c(as.character(1:18), "WC", "Div", "Conf", "SB")

# Show every week that has at least one submitted pick, not just decided ones
weeks <- unique(picks$week)
weeks <- weeks[order(match(weeks, week_levels))]

# --- Week picker dropdown ---
cat('<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">\n')
cat('<label for="week-select"><strong>Select Week: </strong></label>\n')
cat('<select id="week-select" onchange="showWeek(this.value)">\n')
for (w in weeks) {
  cat(paste0('<option value="week-', w, '">Week ', w, '</option>\n'))
}
cat('</select>\n</div>\n')

cat('<script>
function showWeek(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".week-block").forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = "none"; });
  document.getElementById(id).style.display = "block";
}
</script>\n')

# --- One hidden/shown block per week ---
for (w in weeks) {

  display_style <- if (w == weeks[1]) "block" else "none"
  cat(paste0('<div id="week-', w, '" class="week-block" style="display:', display_style, ';">\n'))
  cat(paste0("<h3>Week ", w, "</h3>\n"))
  cat("<p><em>Bonus picks are <strong>bolded</strong>.</em></p>\n")

  week_totals <- weekly_summary %>%
    filter(week == w) %>%
    arrange(desc(week_dollars)) %>%
    select(
      Participant  = user,
      Correct      = correct,
      Total        = total,
      `Base $`     = base_dollars,
      `Bonus $`    = bonus_dollars,
      `Missed $`   = missed_dollars,
      `Week Total` = week_dollars
    )

  if (nrow(week_totals) > 0) {
    print(kable(week_totals))
  } else {
    cat("_Scores pending — check back once results are entered._\n")
  }
  cat("\n")

  # Picks table shows immediately on submission — Correct Pick stays blank
  # until that game's result is entered in the Games tab
  week_detail <- results %>%
    filter(week == w) %>%
    mutate(pick_display = ifelse(bonus, paste0("**", pick, "**"), pick)) %>%
    select(game_id, team_away, team_home, spread, correct_pick, user, pick_display) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(game_id, team_away, team_home, spread, correct_pick),
      names_from  = user,
      values_from = pick_display
    )

  # Ensure every participant has a column, even if they made no picks this week
  for (u in setdiff(all_users, names(week_detail))) {
    week_detail[[u]] <- NA_character_
  }

  week_detail <- week_detail %>%
    mutate(Game = paste(team_away, "at", team_home)) %>%
    select(Game, Spread = spread, `Correct Pick` = correct_pick, all_of(all_users))

  print(kable(week_detail))
  cat("\n")

  cat("</div>\n")
}
```
